verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Over all the earth
You reign on high
Every mountain, stream, every sunset sky

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
But my one request, Lord my only aim
Is that You reign in me again

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Lord reign in me
Reign in Your power
Over all my dreams
In my darkest hour

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You are the Lord of all I am
Won't You reign in me again

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Over every thought
Over every word
May my life reflect the beauty of my Lord

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
'Cause You mean more to me than any earthly thing
So won't You reign in me again
